name: BA-55
author: swtdr34mz
tagline: A bassline after the Erica Synths DB-01, with only what the DB-01 has: one VCO, sub, noise, BBD detune, overdrive, a Polivoks-style LP/BP filter, and its 64-step sequencer
description: A monophonic bassline after the Erica Synths Bassline DB-01, with only the instrument's own controls: one VCO (triangle, saw, square), a transistor-style sub-oscillator, noise into the filter, BBD-style DETUNE (faster as it rises, FM at the end), OVERDRIVE as a blend, FM LVL from the LFO, a saturating 12 dB Polivoks / Acidbox-style filter (low-pass or band-pass, self-oscillating) with decay and depth, a sustain-release VCA (fully up: a drone), an LFO with 10 shapes, sync and reset, accent and slide per step. The DB-01 sequencer: 64 steps with note, gate 10..100 %, accent, slide, a modulation track (recorded live with REC and the cutoff), a pitch envelope per step, probability per step, last step, play modes FWD / BWD / RND / PP / PP2, shuffle, transpose, RND PATT with limits, 8 scales and an arpeggiator. 16 presets with patterns, MIDI clock in. Unofficial.
credits: Built on fm1-base (Charles Vestal) and felucca-bsp (Leo Kuroshita, Hügelton Instruments).
